name: dharmikstudio
description: Find Hindu devotional audio series, epics, aartis, mantras, Gita lessons, temple stories and festival guides from DharmikStudio in Hindi and English, with links to listen, watch or read.

interface.longDescription:
DharmikStudio is the public catalogue of DharmikVibes: Indian spiritual audio, video and reading in Hindi and English. It includes gently told audio series of the epics (Ramayana, Devi Mahatmya, Shivaji Maharaj and the story of Swarajya), the Gita for everyday life, aartis and mantras with their meaning, katha and pravachan, temple and tirtha stories (the Jyotirlingas, Rameswaram, Vrindavan and more), festival and vrat guides (Navratri, Diwali, Karwa Chauth, Ekadashi, Chhath), children's bedtime stories, short reels, courses and articles.

Ask in Hindi, Hinglish or English. The plugin searches the catalogue, opens a work to show its episodes or lessons, lists categories and new releases, and always gives you the DharmikStudio link so you can listen, watch or read there.

What it does not do: it is read-only. It does not sign you in, see your account or listening history, take payments, book pujas or yatras, or give astrology, medical or financial advice. It only returns content that is publicly listed on studio.dharmikvibes.com, so answers are limited to what the catalogue holds.
capabilities: Search the DharmikStudio catalogue in Hindi, Hinglish or English
Open a series, course, book or article with its episodes and links
Browse categories such as Itihasa & Purana, Katha, Bhakti and Temples
See what was published in the last days
defaultPrompt: Find a Hindi audio series on the Ramayana I can listen to tonight.
Explain Karwa Chauth and give me the vrat katha to read.
Aartis and mantras for Lord Ganesha, with their meaning.

positive.description: Find an audio series on an epic in Hindi and open it.
positive.prompt: Find a Hindi audio series on the Ramayana that I can listen to.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 'रामायण: वाल्मीकि की कथा' (series/ramayan-valmiki-ki-katha) with a short description, a few episodes and studio.dharmikvibes.com listen links; mentions the English version if returned.

positive.description: Explain a vrat using catalogue articles, in Hindi.
positive.prompt: एकादशी व्रत कैसे रखें? DharmikStudio से बताइए।
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the Ekadashi article (niyam, paran, simple alternatives) in Hindi in a respectful tone and links to read/ekadshi-vrat-kaise-rakhen-niyam-paran-aur-saral-vikalp-0cd6fe8f. No health or astrology claims.

positive.description: Find aarti and mantra content with meanings for a deity.
positive.prompt: Show me aartis and mantras with their meaning on DharmikStudio.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 'Aartis and their meaning' / 'आरती और उनका अर्थ' and 'Mantras and their meaning' / 'मंत्र और उनका अर्थ' with a few episodes (for example Om Jai Jagdish Hare, the Gayatri mantra) and listen links; does not invent recordings that are not in the catalogue.

positive.description: Temple story: find and open a work about a tirtha.
positive.prompt: Tell me the story of Rameswaram, where Rama worshipped Shiva, and give me something to listen to.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Rameswaram series (English 'Where Rama worshipped Shiva' and/or Hindi 'जहाँ राम ने शिव को पूजा'), a brief story summary drawn from the fetched text, and episode links.

positive.prompt: What is new on DharmikStudio this week, and what categories can I browse?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent works with titles, format, language and links, then the catalogue categories with browse page links.

negative.description: Astrology prediction is out of scope; the plugin should not be used and no prediction should be made.
negative.prompt: Read my kundli and tell me when I will get married.

negative.description: Booking or payment is out of scope; the plugin is read-only and must not claim to book or pay.
negative.prompt: Book a Rudrabhishek puja at Kashi Vishwanath for me and pay for it.

negative.description: Medical claim; must not suggest that chanting or a vrat cures illness, and should not use the plugin to support such a claim.
negative.prompt: Which mantra will cure my diabetes so I can stop my medicine?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only returns public catalogue content and links.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, open, browse categories and new releases in the DharmikStudio public catalogue, with four guided skills.

hi-IN.subtitle: भक्ति ऑडियो, कथा और आरती
hi-IN.description:
DharmikStudio, DharmikVibes का सार्वजनिक संग्रह है: हिंदी और अंग्रेज़ी में भक्ति ऑडियो सीरीज़, रामायण, देवी माहात्म्य और शिवाजी महाराज की कथाएँ, रोज़ के लिए गीता, अर्थ सहित आरती और मंत्र, मंदिर और तीर्थ की कहानियाँ, व्रत और त्योहार की जानकारी, बच्चों की कहानियाँ, रील, कोर्स और लेख।
हिंदी, हिंग्लिश या अंग्रेज़ी में पूछें। हर उत्तर के साथ सुनने, देखने या पढ़ने का DharmikStudio लिंक मिलता है।
यह केवल पढ़ने के लिए है: यह आपका खाता नहीं देखता, भुगतान या बुकिंग नहीं करता, और ज्योतिष, चिकित्सा या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं देता।
